Eight Ball Champ left-orbit and CHAMP strategy demonstration

strategy.overview: Repeat the left orbit and carry the ball across the top into the upper-right saucer. Those shots increase the orbit rollover value, raise Bonus X to 5x, and feed the H-A-M lanes. Complete C-H-A-M-P once for 2x playfield scoring and again for 3x, then keep taking the orbit and saucer. Build the numbered-ball rack only when the orbit route is unavailable or the competition setup weakens it.
strategy.simpleOverview: Repeat the left orbit into the upper-right saucer to build the rollover value and Bonus X. Use lane change to complete unlit C-H-A-M-P lanes; the first set starts 2x playfield scoring and the second starts 3x. Keep shooting the orbit and saucer once both multipliers are ready.
strategy.summary: Repeat the left orbit into the upper-right saucer to reach 5x Bonus and complete C-H-A-M-P twice for 3x playfield scoring. Score unlit lane lamps, not lit ones, and keep using the orbit route unless the machine has been modified.

quickInfo.name: Repeat the Left Orbit
quickInfo.summary: Carry it across the top into the upper-right saucer.

quickInfo.name: Reach 5x Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Each completed left-orbit and saucer route advances Bonus X.

quickInfo.name: Complete CHAMP Twice
quickInfo.summary: The first set starts 2x; the second starts 3x playfield scoring.

quickInfo.name: Choose Unlit Lanes
quickInfo.summary: The lane lamps turn off when their letters are scored.

steps.text: Shoot the left orbit and let it travel across the top to the upper-right saucer; repeat it to raise the orbit value and Bonus X toward 5x.
Use lane change to steer top feeds through unlit H-A-M lanes and return-lane feeds through unlit C or P.
Complete C-H-A-M-P once for 2x playfield scoring and a second time for 3x, then repeat the orbit and saucer for the combined value.
Use the upper-right flipper for additional saucer attempts instead of abandoning a controlled upper-playfield feed.

alternatives.title: Build the numbered-ball rack
alternatives.when: Use this when lane change or orbit values have been disabled, or when a target bank is already close to completion.

steps.text: Collect balls 1–7 or 9–15 from the pool-ball drops and the E-I-G-H-T standups behind them.
Collect the 8-ball last to finish the rack and add its held bonus, then return to the orbit route.
Complete C-H-A-M-P twice and raise Bonus X to 5x before spreading shots across the target banks.
Keep feeding the upper-right saucer, whose value rises after Bonus X is ready.

machineSetup: Check whether lane change, orbit value increments, the left-orbit route, Extra Ball, and Special have been disabled or converted for competition.
Test both orbits, the top saucer and upper-right flipper, H-A-M and C/P lane switches and lamps, all pool-ball drops and E-I-G-H-T standups, spinner, and side drains.

techniques.name: Shatz pass
techniques.instruction: Use a controlled return-lane shatz to move the ball from the left flipper to the right for the left-orbit shot.

techniques.name: Live catch
techniques.instruction: Use a live catch when a dead bounce repeatedly carries too far toward the opposite slingshot.

cautions.issue: Tournament setups may disable lane change or reduce the dominant left-orbit value.
cautions.response: Check the setup first; if the orbit has been weakened, put more weight on held pool-ball bonus and safe right-orbit feeds.
